title: NLP for Counterspeech against Hate: A Survey and How-To Guide

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and synthesizing existing NLP datasets, classification tasks, and generative models (evaluated via standard automated metrics and human evaluation) that aim to detect and generate counterspeech against online hate targeting racial and ethnic minorities (e.g., Black, Asian, and Romani people).
Reviewing literature on datasets and automated NLP counterspeech frameworks specifically targeting hate speech against religious groups, primarily focusing on antisemitism and Islamophobia.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing datasets and computational models designed to classify and generate automated counterspeech to mitigate anti-LGBTQ+ hate speech online.
Examining natural language processing approaches, interaction datasets, and counterspeech mechanisms aimed at identifying and responding to misogyny and hate speech directed at women.
Reviewing NLP research, data collection procedures, and generative language models focused on countering xenophobia and anti-migrant hate speech.
Surveying computational approaches and available text datasets utilized for mitigating online hate speech and abusive language directed at disabled individuals.
Reviewing existing datasets and NLP models designed to identify and produce text-based counterspeech against hate speech targeting overweight individuals.
